description.value: Play Estate Winery is an estate winery and restaurant perched on Skaha Hills Drive with sweeping, unobstructed views of Skaha Lake and the surrounding mountains, just minutes from downtown Penticton. The property houses both a wine shop carrying estate-grown wines crafted by winemaker Rebecca Ruggeri and The Vista Restaurant, which serves flatbreads, charcuterie, seafood, and other light fare. The winery's arts-inspired identity — its name evoking theatre and the spirit of Shakespeare — lends it a distinctive character among the Okanagan's many wine destinations.

address.value: 507 Skaha Hills Drive, Penticton, BC V2A 0A9
